load_text_model_for_vlm: load a text model (llama, mistral, gemma, paligemma) for a vision-language model using prefix config and weights
load_vision_model_for_vlm: load a vision model (clip or siglip) for a vision-language model using prefix config and weights
load_text_model_llama: load a FlashLlamaForCausalLM text model for a VLM by passing a llama config and weights
load_text_model_gemma: load a FlashGemmaForCausalLM text model for a VLM by passing a gemma config and weights
load_vision_model_siglip: load a SiglipVisionTransformer vision model for a VLM by passing a siglip config and weights
